metadata.title: Data Space
metadata.description: What the Data Space is and which services it includes

header.title: Data Space
header.lead: OneHealth DataSpace brings together the whole data lifecycle on one trusted platform: sharing, analyzing, computing and publishing.

whatIs.title: What is the Data Space?
whatIs.text1: A traditional data space stops at sharing. OneHealth DataSpace goes further: the same platform also gives you the computing power, the analytics and the publishing services you need to turn shared data into results, without ever leaving the trusted space.
whatIs.text2: Each organization keeps control of its data throughout the whole process, under a common framework of governance and trust.

features.title: What does the Data Space include?
features.governance: Sharing agreements, usage policies and traceability throughout the data lifecycle.
